rules.title: Generic or Common Name
rules.description: Every package shall bear the generic or common name of the commodity.

evaluation.fail_condition: Field is absent, empty, or not legible

rules.title: Net Quantity
rules.description: Every package shall declare the net quantity in terms of standard units of weights or measures.

evaluation.pass_condition: Net quantity present with numeric value and recognized SI unit (g, kg, ml, L, nos, m, cm)
evaluation.fail_condition: Net quantity absent, not in standard units, or ambiguous

rules.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name and Address
rules.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer or importer, as applicable.

evaluation.pass_condition: Name and address of manufacturer, packer, or importer present
evaluation.fail_condition: Name or address absent or incomplete

rules.title: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
rules.description: Month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed, or imported shall be declared.

evaluation.pass_condition: Month and year present in any standard format (MM/YYYY, Mon YYYY, MM-YYYY, etc.)
evaluation.fail_condition: Manufacturing date absent or only year without month present
evaluation.note: For products with expiry date less than 3 months, day-month-year may be required

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.description: Maximum retail price (inclusive of all taxes) at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the ultimate consumer.

evaluation.pass_condition: MRP declared with ₹ or Rs. prefix, inclusive of all taxes, numeric value > 0
evaluation.fail_condition: MRP absent, not in rupees, or does not state inclusive of all taxes

rules.title: Consumer Care Details
rules.description: Name, address, and telephone number of the person who can be contacted in case of consumer complaint.

evaluation.pass_condition: Consumer care contact (name + address OR phone/email) is present

rules.title: Country of Origin (for imported goods)
rules.description: Country of origin of commodity for imported commodities.

evaluation.pass_condition: Country of origin stated, OR product is domestically manufactured
evaluation.fail_condition: Imported product but country of origin absent
evaluation.applicability_note: Only required if product is imported

rules.title: Unit Sale Price (Multi-piece packages)
rules.description: For packages containing multiple pieces, the retail price of each piece shall be declared.

evaluation.pass_condition: Unit sale price declared for each piece, OR package contains only one unit
evaluation.fail_condition: Multi-piece package without unit sale price
evaluation.applicability_note: Only for packages containing more than one consumer unit

rules.title: Expiry Date / Best Before Date
rules.description: Best before or expiry date for commodities with shelf life up to 30 months shall be declared.

evaluation.pass_condition: Expiry or best before date present in recognized format
evaluation.fail_condition: Perishable/food/cosmetic product without expiry or best before date

rules.title: Numeral Size for Net Quantity Declaration
rules.description: The declaration of net quantity shall be in numerals of specific minimum height based on package principal display panel area.

evaluation.pass_condition: Numerals meet minimum height for declared package size
evaluation.fail_condition: Numerals too small for package display panel area
evaluation.note: Physical measurement required - cannot be determined from image alone

rules.title: Placement of Net Quantity Declaration
rules.description: The declaration of net quantity shall be on the principal display panel, in the lower third portion.

evaluation.pass_condition: Net quantity visible and in lower portion of principal display panel
evaluation.fail_condition: Net quantity hidden, obscured, or not on principal display panel
evaluation.note: Approximate placement assessment only from image

rules.title: Manner of Expressing Net Quantity
rules.description: Net quantity in solid shall be by weight, liquid by volume, otherwise by count.

evaluation.pass_condition: Net quantity unit matches product state (solid → weight, liquid → volume, others → count)
evaluation.fail_condition: Wrong type of unit used (e.g., volume for solid product)

rules.title: Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) — Net Quantity
rules.description: The net quantity of the commodity shall not be less than the declared quantity minus the applicable Maximum Permissible Error.

evaluation.pass_condition: Measured net quantity ≥ declared quantity - MPE
evaluation.fail_condition: Measured net quantity < declared quantity - MPE
evaluation.note: Cannot be determined from image alone. Physical weighing/measurement required.
